title: Stems, MIDI and two more skins
thisBuild: Messes, Pour it out, For a DAW: Stems makes a zip with every sound as its own WAV, all starting at the same moment, so they drop straight into a DAW and line up.
MIDI makes a file with the notes, one track per sound, named after it. Loud steps are full velocity, quiet ones soft, and a step's pitch carries over.
Both work for the current loop or the whole song.
Two more skins in Settings, Skin: Felt and Paper (daylight, ink words on warm paper, felt pads) and Rust (oxide browns and green, heavy grit).
Also in this build if you skipped the last one: Edit, the perform row, step strengths, 16 Levels, step chance (hold a step) and skins (Settings, Skin).
watch: Send the stems to your computer and drop them in your DAW: do they line up with each other?
Open the MIDI file: is every sound on its own track, in time?
Felt and Paper outside in the sun: can you read everything, the status bar too?
limits: Each stem goes through the master squash on its own, so the stems added up are close to the mix but not exact.
A MIDI file has no dice: steps set to 50% or 1st of 2 are written as if they always play.
There is no master bus control yet (a glue or squash amount); the gentle squash on the mix is the same as before.
Felt and Paper is the first light skin: a few corners may still be dark or hard to read. Send a note with a screenshot if so.
